eyebrow.zh: 把封面风格、模型参数与标题布局保存成可锁定的 style-pack，重复生成并检查一套封面。
eyebrow.en: Save cover style, model parameters and title layout in a lockable style pack, then generate and inspect a consistent cover set.

headline.zh:
锁定一套风格，
反复生成封面
headline.en:
Lock a style.
Build the next cover set.

sub.zh: 把封面风格、模型参数与标题布局保存成可锁定的 style-pack，重复生成并检查一套封面。
sub.en: Save cover style, model parameters and title layout in a lockable style pack, then generate and inspect a consistent cover set.

caption.zh: 风格锁定 · 本地合成

body.zh: 一个 YAML pack 保存模型、提示词和布局。
body.en: A YAML pack stores model, prompt and layout choices.

body.zh: 合成阶段的标题边界写入 sidecar。
body.en: Compose-time title bounds are saved in the sidecar.

body.zh: regen 对指定索引重新合成，保留其他封面文件。
body.en: regen recomposes the selected index while retaining other cover files.

title.zh: 让下一张封面延续已有设置
title.en: Carry your settings into the next cover

body.zh: 批量做封面时，模型视觉、标题排版和平台尺寸通常要反复配置。CoverLock 把这些设置收进 YAML style-pack，锁定后复用同一套参数，并将每张封面的尺寸与标题边界记录在 sidecar 中供 gallery 检查。
body.en: Cover batches require repeated decisions about image style, title layout and canvas dimensions. CoverLock keeps those choices in a YAML style pack, reuses its locked settings, and records size and title bounds in sidecars for gallery inspection.

body.zh: 实际运行 3 张封面的离线 mock 流程，验证锁定、合成、单张重绘和 gallery。3/3 是本次输入的本地几何检查结果，不证明模型画质或平台审核通过。
body.en: The real three-cover offline mock run exercises locking, composition, one-cover regeneration and gallery creation. The 3/3 result is a local geometry check for these inputs, not model-quality or platform-acceptance evidence.

alt.zh: 实际运行 3 张封面的离线 mock 流程，验证锁定、合成、单张重绘和 gallery。3/3 是本次输入的本地几何检查结果，不证明模型画质或平台审核通过。
alt.en: The real three-cover offline mock run exercises locking, composition, one-cover regeneration and gallery creation. The 3/3 result is a local geometry check for these inputs, not model-quality or platform-acceptance evidence.

body.zh: stylepack.py 管理 YAML 和锁定摘要；模型 adapter 生成无文字底图；compose.py 按 rules.py 的尺寸与安全区排标题；gallery.py 读取实际合成时的合规记录拼图。模型能力与本地排版检查是不同环节。
body.en: stylepack.py owns YAML and lock hashes. Model adapters create text-free visuals; compose.py places titles using dimensions and safe zones from rules.py. gallery.py builds a contact sheet from recorded compose-time checks. Model quality and local layout checks are separate concerns.

alt.zh: stylepack.py 管理 YAML 和锁定摘要；模型 adapter 生成无文字底图；compose.py 按 rules.py 的尺寸与安全区排标题；gallery.py 读取实际合成时的合规记录拼图。模型能力与本地排版检查是不同环节。
alt.en: stylepack.py owns YAML and lock hashes. Model adapters create text-free visuals; compose.py places titles using dimensions and safe zones from rules.py. gallery.py builds a contact sheet from recorded compose-time checks. Model quality and local layout checks are separate concerns.

body.zh: 文件输入和本地合成层可离线使用，远程模型只负责底图。用 models、rules 查看当前 backend 与几何规则；gallery 读取合成时记录的标题边界，而不是仅看固定尺寸。
body.en: File inputs and local composition work offline; remote models supply only the base image. Use models and rules to inspect available routes. Gallery reads recorded title bounds from composition rather than judging only canvas size.

alt.zh: 文件输入和本地合成层可离线使用，远程模型只负责底图。用 models、rules 查看当前 backend 与几何规则；gallery 读取合成时记录的标题边界，而不是仅看固定尺寸。
alt.en: File inputs and local composition work offline; remote models supply only the base image. Use models and rules to inspect available routes. Gallery reads recorded title bounds from composition rather than judging only canvas size.

body.zh: 改动锁定字段需重新 lock；已有套图要按新风格整体重生成。
body.en: Relock after editing locked fields, then regenerate existing sets under the new style.

note.zh: 实际运行 3 张封面的离线 mock 流程，验证锁定、合成、单张重绘和 gallery。3/3 是本次输入的本地几何检查结果，不证明模型画质或平台审核通过。
note.en: The real three-cover offline mock run exercises locking, composition, one-cover regeneration and gallery creation. The 3/3 result is a local geometry check for these inputs, not model-quality or platform-acceptance evidence.

body.zh: 对示例 pack 计算并保存锁定摘要。
body.en: Compute and store the example pack lock.

steps.output:
locked examples/presentation-pack.yaml
locked_sha: f3dab7a4a2c7cc0cdb3aad0575d091dd5a2c061621497f26e44876c966a8b4a6
the style is now frozen; any edit to a locked field will be detected.

body.zh: 内置 mock 生成三张，尺寸与标题边界检查为 3/3。
body.en: The built-in mock generates three covers with 3/3 size and title checks.

steps.command: python -m coverlock.cli gen --pack examples/presentation-pack.yaml --titles examples/presentation-titles.txt --out examples/presentation-output
steps.output:
coverlock gen · pack=presentation (locked) · model=mock · size=4:5 (1080x1350) · 3 title(s)
  [✓] cover_01.png  1080x1350  size=✓ safe-zone=✓
  [✓] cover_02.png  1080x1350  size=✓ safe-zone=✓
  [✓] cover_03.png  1080x1350  size=✓ safe-zone=✓
done · size-compliant 3/3 · titles-in-safe-zone 3/3 · out=examples/presentation-output

body.en: The second cover receives a new title.

steps.command: python -m coverlock.cli regen --pack examples/presentation-pack.yaml --out examples/presentation-output --index 2 --title "Read something new"
steps.output: regenerated cover 02 → examples/presentation-output/cover_02.png (same locked pack; other covers untouched)

body.zh: gallery 汇总本地合成记录。
body.en: Gallery summarizes the recorded local composition checks.

body.zh: 需要 Python 3.12+。安装依赖需要网络，示例使用内置 mock，不需要模型 key。
body.en: Requires Python 3.12+. Installation needs network access; the demo uses the built-in mock without model credentials.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/coverlock.git
cd coverlock
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install -e .

python -m coverlock.cli lock examples/presentation-pack.yaml
python -m coverlock.cli gen --pack examples/presentation-pack.yaml --titles examples/presentation-titles.txt --out examples/presentation-output
python -m coverlock.cli regen --pack examples/presentation-pack.yaml --out examples/presentation-output --index 2 --title "Read something new"
python -m coverlock.cli gallery --out examples/presentation-output

limitations.zh: mock 是离线占位视觉，不能代表豆包或 Qwen 的图像质量。
limitations.en: Mock visuals are offline fixtures, not evidence of Doubao or Qwen image quality.

limitations.zh: 安全区检查遵循仓库规则表，不等于平台审核或所有标题都能适配。
limitations.en: Safe-zone checks follow repository rules; they do not guarantee platform acceptance or fit for every title.

limitations.zh: 不自动发布内容，也不提供已上线的托管套餐。
limitations.en: The tool does not publish content automatically or provide a live hosted plan.
